Base records: Federal Equipment Company Cincinnati (naval deck machinery; Trident Heavy Equipment precedent), AmFELS Brownsville (WTIV delivered Sep 2025; yard sold to Karpower Valley 2026-01-30, all Seatrium projects delivered before the sale: operation as a builder now unconfirmed, flagged in a status row), Feeney Shipyard Kingston (barge and dry dock, 2025), Mississippi Marine Greenville (Nichols Boat towboat hull erection, July 2022), Eagle Fabrication Sauget (barges; latest dated launch June 2022), Mike's Inc. riverfront shipyard (spec towboat Feb 2022; mainly repair). Three of the six rest on a single dated build from 2022 (inside the five-year window of R2 boundary reading 1, which the earlier ships passes did not use: they required 2023+). prospect_test is inferred on all six (new construction at the site; steel not named on most pages). Headcount: stated OSHA rows for AmFELS, Feeney, Mississippi Marine, Eagle; inferred for Federal Equipment (record ZIP 23320 is garbled) and Mike's (record is the South Roxana main facility). Already in the ledger: Lakeshore Systems x4 = Trident Heavy Equipment Group (Rhinelander, Iron River, Ontonagon, Kingsford; same addresses), Cascade General = Vigor Portland, Alabama Shipyard x3, Arcosa Ashland City, C&C Marine, Main Industries North Charleston; no evidence written onto existing plants.
